create_corrblock_pyramid: create a CorrBlock from two feature maps to build a multi-level correlation pyramid for optical flow
sample_correlation_with_coords: sample correlation values from a CorrBlock pyramid at given coordinate positions using bilinear interpolation
compute_allpairs_correlation: compute the all-pairs correlation between two feature map tensors using matrix multiplication and normalization
create_alternate_corrblock: create an AlternateCorrBlock from two feature maps to build a multi-level pyramid for CUDA-accelerated correlation
sample_alternate_correlation: sample correlation values from an AlternateCorrBlock pyramid at given coordinates using the alt_cuda_corr CUDA kernel
